meta.title: FileMaker diagnostic code lookup
meta.adaptation: Local adaptation: numeric inventory retained; diagnostic summaries independently rewritten; examples and handling guidance replaced. Upstream attribution does not imply a license grant over Claris documentation.
meta.license_note: Independently written diagnostic summaries; not the official Claris wording.
meta.coverage: 292 individually listed codes, including -1 and 0; upstream identifies FileMaker 26 coverage. Grouped ranges are documented separately, not expanded.

excluded_ranges.meaning: Plug-in-defined results; consult the relevant vendor.
Solution-defined results supplied through Revert Transaction.

meta.verification: Checked against the local upstream numeric inventory; not engine-tested or independently verified against the current official page.
